auth: Requires a Bearer token for a user with role `customer`, unless noted.
note: Availability (getUpcomingDays/getTimeSlots in src/utils/availability.ts) is computed client-side from the business's workingHours only — there's no server-side conflict check against existing bookings yet, since this is the first phase to create bookings at all. A real implementation should move slot generation server-side once it has bookings to check against. STK push is fully mocked (confirm-booking-payment below) — no real M-Pesa integration exists yet; that's still an open decision (sandbox vs. provider).

endpoints.description: Creates a booking once the customer confirms service(s), staff, and date/time on the Review & Policies screen. Returns status=confirmed immediately if the business requires no deposit; otherwise status=pending_payment until confirm-booking-payment (or a real STK push webhook) settles it.

errors.message: The selected time is no longer available

endpoints.description: Sends the M-Pesa STK push for a pending_payment booking's deposit and returns once it settles. A real implementation is async (STK push, then a callback/webhook updates the booking; this endpoint would need to either poll or the client would subscribe to a status endpoint) — the mock layer (src/api/booking.ts#confirmBookingPayment) simplifies this to a single request that resolves after a fixed delay, always succeeding.
